description: Three MISRA-rule chains with identical structural template. detectCausalPatterns should recognise and promote to staging.

assertions.because: Three identical template instances meet the staging threshold of 3
Template normalisation should abstract specific rules to entity type and predicate category
instance_count reflects the number of matching concrete chains
avg_strength is mean of the 3 edges' strength (all 0.8)
All three edges must be linked to the detected pattern
At 3 instances, pattern cannot yet be promoted to candidate (threshold = 5)

detect_duration_ms.because: Detection on 3 chains must be near-instant

graduation_notes: When this scenario passes reliably, advance to: (a) seven-identical-chains (meets candidate threshold 5) — verify promotion + Haiku naming called, (b) noisy-similar-chains (2 identical + 1 near-miss) — verify normalisation does not over-merge, (c) partial-chain-for-ghost (2.5 of 3 steps) — precursor to ghost detection tests.
